approval_policy: Human-reviewed exact file SHA-256, declared certificate identifiers and source stage. Empty list means no causal input admission. This is not a scientific proof of the contents.
notes: Previous C3X P15/P16/P32 scientific achievements remain historically valid within their recorded scopes; they are not automatically admitted as 0.12 certificates.
Raw UCI smoke packets and synthetic fixtures have no causal explanation authority.
Repository human review of a certificate must preserve scope, source, engine and local-only limitations before it is allowlisted.
